facts.function: network security: one-way data transfer (data diode), keyboard/multi-computer switching, data pump software
facts.form: group of different articles (data diode device, keyboard switch, multiple computer switch, software); unclear whether a single set or separate products

gri_path: GRI 1: candidates are 8517.62 (machines for reception, conversion and transmission of data), 8471.80 (control or adapter units of ADP machines) and 8523 (software media)
GRI 3(b)/set question not resolved because the description does not say how the items are entered or what each device does

rejected_alternatives.reason: possible if the data diode transmits data over a network, not confirmed
possible if the devices are control or adapter units of an ADP system, not confirmed
a data diode device here is a network appliance, not a discrete semiconductor diode

missing_facts: Is the data diode a stand-alone network appliance that transmits data between networks (heading 8517) or a unit that only interfaces with a computer (heading 8471)?
Are the four items imported together as one retail set, or entered as separate articles (classify separately: Keyboard Switch, Multiple Computer Switch, Data Pump software)?
What do the keyboard switch and computer switch switch (video/USB signals for KVM use)?
Is the software supplied on a physical medium or only as a download/licence?
classification.rationale: The first-named article, the data diode, could fall in 8517.62 or 8471.80 depending on function and network role; the group may also be a GRI 3(b) set. Searched rulings (G85043, F81925) did not match the facts, so none are cited. Asking the importer instead of guessing the 6-digit.
